definitionZh: caret-color CSS 属性设置了插入cet的颜色,有时被称为文本输入光标. 这是显示在插入点的可见标记,该插入点将输入下一个字符,或者删除下一个字符。
sourceDefinition: The caret-color CSS property sets the color of the insertion caret, sometimes referred to as the text input cursor. This is the visible marker appearing at the insertion point where the next character typed will be added or where the next character deleted will be removed.
